patch.summary: Update the organization's time rounding rule
patch.description: A direction and an increment, either or both. Nothing already saved changes: the rule rounds time saved from now on, and open time is re-rounded only by `/time-rounding-recalculation`, after a preview. Executive managers and administrators only.

get.summary: Preview re-rounding open time under the current rules
get.description: What the apply would change, writing nothing: how many open entries change, their rounded hours before and after, a breakdown by project, the date span, and what is left alone and why. Open means the same as for a single edit: stopped, not invoiced, not approved, on an unlocked date, under an active client, project and task. The `fingerprint` names exactly this set. Executive managers and administrators only.

post.summary: Re-round open time under the current rules
post.description: Applies the preview whose `fingerprint` is sent, for the same scope. If anything has changed since that preview, nothing is written and the answer is 409 `preview_stale`. Executive managers and administrators only.

post.summary: Create or start a time entry
post.description: `started_time` with `ended_time` logs a stopped start/end entry in either organization mode, its `seconds` derived from the two times (an end before the start is past midnight); `seconds` beside them is 422 `mode_mismatch`. Without times the organization's `time_entry_mode` decides: in `duration`, `seconds` logs a stopped entry and leaving it out starts a timer; in `start_end`, leaving out `ended_time` starts a timer at the current local time and `seconds` is 422 `mode_mismatch`. A timer in a `duration` organization never carries times, so `started_time` without `ended_time` there is 422 `mode_mismatch`. Entries may overlap; each counts its own full duration.

get.summary: Get a time entry

patch.description: An entry keeps the shape it was created with, whatever the organization's mode: a start/end entry takes `started_time` and `ended_time` and re-derives `seconds`, a duration entry takes `seconds`, and the other is 422 `mode_mismatch`.

List invoices
get.description: Newest first: by issue_date, latest first; then by number, highest first -- compared as a number when it is made of digits alone (leading zeros ignored) and as text, by Unicode code point, otherwise, with all-digit numbers ahead of the rest on a day that has both; then by id, highest first, so no two invoices tie. The first page fixes the traversal to the invoices that existed when it was read: an invoice created after it does not appear on later pages of the same traversal, and is listed by a new one. Editing an invoice's issue_date or number moves it in the order, so a traversal already under way may miss it or list it twice. The number parameter narrows the list to the invoice with exactly that number, compared as text, so 089 is not 89; numbers are unique, so the page holds that invoice or nothing.

ActivityLogActor.description: Who caused the event. type and id are what the event recorded; name is resolved when the log is read, so it is the person's current name. name is null for a system actor and for an id that no user or contact carries any more.

GeneralResource.description: Commercial fields are omitted without finance/admin authority or an explicit billable_rates_manager grant. The same authority is required to set them; resource read/write scopes still apply.

GeneralMutationInput.description: Commercial fields listed on GeneralResource require the same commercial authority for create and update, in addition to resource write scope.

invoice_id.description: Omitted without invoices:read authority (profile and token).

is_billed.description: Omitted without invoices:read authority (profile and token).

user_id.description: Whose entry. Defaults to the acting user. Only an administrator may name somebody else, and only for stopped time: a timer is started by the person it tracks.

seconds.description: A duration entry's length. Not accepted with started_time or ended_time.

started_time.description: Canonical 24-hour HH:MM. With ended_time, a stopped start/end entry in either organization mode.

ended_time.description: Canonical 24-hour HH:MM. Requires started_time and spent_date.

EffectiveTimeRounding.description: The rule an entry on a project is saved under, and whose it is.
